tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches low on a rocky ledge, one knee near the ground, peering over the edge with narrowed eyes while its tail curls upward behind it.
tasks.camera: three-quarter low-angle medium shot from the side
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands tucked near the chest and feet flat on the ledge, not clearly visible; identity and style only.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝色老虎蹲在岩壁上警觉地向边缘张望，保持角色身份与赛璐璐风格。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans far back in a wooden chair, balancing it on two rear legs, one arm flung out for balance and the other gripping the seat edge.
tasks.camera: full-body side view at chair height
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands clearly visible gripping and reaching; feet obscured behind the chair.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎把木椅向后倾斜保持平衡，双手清晰可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger hangs upside down from a horizontal tree branch by its knees, arms dangling toward the ground and ears flipped forward as it grins.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both dangling hands fully visible; knees grip branch, feet not shown.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎用膝弯倒挂在树枝上，双臂下垂，双手可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crawls on all fours through a low tunnel, shoulders hunched, head turned back toward the viewer with an amused expression.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both front paws and both hind soles turned toward camera, all digits and yellow pads clearly visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎在低矮隧道中爬行并回头，四肢与掌垫清晰可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits cross-legged on a woven mat, holding a small clay cup in both paws and blowing gently across its rim, tail wrapped around one leg.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands wrapped around the cup with all fingers visible; feet crossed and hidden.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎盘腿坐着双手捧杯轻吹，双手手指清晰。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger presses both palms flat against a tall glass window and peers through it, nose nearly touching the pane, tail lifted straight behind.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms flat on glass, five fingers and yellow palm pads clearly visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎双掌按在玻璃窗上向里张望，手掌与掌垫清晰。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger balances on a narrow log over a stream, arms outstretched, one foot lifted mid-step and toes spread for grip.
tasks.camera: side full-body view at log level
tasks.visibility_requirement: Lifted sole turned toward camera showing four toes and yellow pad; arms out and hands visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎在独木桥上抬脚保持平衡，抬起的脚掌与掌垫清晰。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels to sketch on paper spread over the floor, one hand steadying the sheet and the other holding a stick of charcoal above it.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible from above, fingers distinct around paper and charcoal; feet folded beneath, hidden.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎跪地画画，双手与手指从上方清晰可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger reclines on a hammock strung between two trees, one leg draped over the edge, reading a small book held above its face.
tasks.camera: side medium shot at hammock height
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands gripping the book visibly; draped foot turned away and not assessable.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎躺在吊床上看书，双手握书清晰可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger scrambles up a steep sandy bank, claws digging in, body angled diagonally and tail trailing downward.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands digging into sand clearly visible with fingers spread; feet behind body, hidden.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎攀爬陡峭沙坡，双爪抓沙清晰，手指可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on its side on a smooth floor, one arm tucked under its head and the other hand tapping a small drum beside it.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Tapping hand and tucked hand both visible from above; feet out of frame.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎侧躺敲小鼓，双手从俯视角度清晰。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger steps high through tall grass, one knee lifted sharply, both hands parting the stalks ahead like curtains.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands parting grass visible; lifted foot sole turned toward camera showing four toes and yellow pad.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎在草丛中高抬腿分草前行，双手与抬脚掌垫清晰。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a swivel stool at a workbench, leaning close to inspect a tiny gear held in one paw while the other steadies a magnifier.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands near the face clearly visible, fingers distinct around gear and magnifier; feet hidden.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎坐在工作台前仔细检查齿轮，双手与手指清晰。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans out from a rooftop edge, one hand shading its eyes and the other gripping the ledge, city rooftops stretching behind.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Shading hand and gripping hand visible over the ledge; lower body below parapet, feet hidden.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎从屋顶边缘探身远望，双手可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger tucks into a tight forward roll across a gym mat, body curled and tail wrapped close, mid-tumble motion.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Limbs tucked into the roll and not individually assessable; identity and style only.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎在垫子上前滚翻，身体蜷缩，保持身份与风格。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lowers itself into a shallow river, hands trailing in the current and head tilted to watch ripples spread.
tasks.camera: front medium shot near water level
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands submerged to wrists but palms turned up toward camera, fingers and yellow pads visible through clear water.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎在浅河中涉水，手掌上翻透过清水可见掌垫。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger perches atop a tall ladder, one leg hooked over a rung, both hands folding a large paper map.
tasks.camera: side full-body shot at ladder height
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands folding the map clearly visible; hooked foot turned away, not assessable.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎坐在梯子上折地图，双手与手指清晰。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger pushes a heavy crate across a wooden floor, shoulders lowered, back leg braced far behind and head down.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both braced hind soles facing camera with four toes and yellow pads clearly visible; hands hidden against crate.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎用力推木箱，后脚掌与掌垫清晰可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies prone on a beach towel, propped on both elbows, flipping through a magazine spread on the sand.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Flipping hands visible at the magazine; both bare soles raised behind toward camera with four toes and yellow pads.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎趴在海滩毛巾上翻杂志，双手与抬起脚掌清晰。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger stands at an easel outdoors, one hand steadying a palette and the other raising a brush toward the canvas.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palette hand and brush hand both fully visible with fingers distinct; feet behind easel, hidden.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎在户外画架前作画，双手与手指清晰。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches behind a low wall in a snowfield, one hand pressed to the snow for support and the other raised to shield its face from falling flakes.
tasks.camera: side medium shot at wall height
tasks.visibility_requirement: Supporting hand and shielding hand both visible with fingers distinct; feet behind wall, hidden.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎躲在雪地矮墙后抬手挡雪，双手可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger swings hand-over-hand along a rope bridge, body stretched between rungs, tail swinging with the motion.
tasks.camera: low-angle full-body shot from below the bridge
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both gripping hands clearly visible above on the rope; feet dangling but not turned to camera.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎沿绳桥交替攀荡，双手抓绳清晰。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on the floor assembling a model ship, one hand holding the hull and the other pinching a tiny mast into place.
tasks.camera: close high-angle shot over the shoulder
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands and fingers clearly visible around the model; feet crossed under body, hidden.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎坐地拼装模型船，双手与手指清晰。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger vaults over a park bench sideways, one hand planted on the backrest and legs swept horizontally.
tasks.camera: side action shot at bench height
tasks.visibility_requirement: Planted hand visible on the backrest; other hand and feet blurred in motion, not assessable.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎侧身跃过公园长椅，支撑手可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger stands on a drifting raft, one hand holding a long pole and the other cupped around its mouth as it calls across the water.
tasks.camera: wide three-quarter shot from the shore
tasks.visibility_requirement: Pole hand and cupped hand both clearly visible with fingers; feet planted on raft, not assessable.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎站在木筏上撑杆呼喊，双手清晰可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger bends deeply at the waist to inspect a flower, one hand on its knee and the other gently lifting a petal.
tasks.camera: side medium shot at waist height
tasks.visibility_requirement: Knee hand and petal-lifting hand clearly visible with fingers; feet planted and out of frame.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎弯腰细看花朵，双手可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger is half-submerged in a bubble bath, one foot raised above the foam while both hands scrub a washcloth over its shoulder.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Raised sole turned toward camera above foam showing four toes and yellow pad; both hands visible scrubbing.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎泡澡抬起一只脚，脚掌与掌垫清晰。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels on a rug and reaches deep under a bed with one arm, cheek pressed to the floor and tail flicking.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Reaching hand extended toward camera with five fingers visible; both bare soles turned up behind with four toes and yellow pads.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎趴地伸手探入床底，伸出的手与脚掌清晰。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits back-to-back with a large stone statue, mimicking its pose with arms folded and chin lifted proudly.
tasks.camera: wide side shot at statue height
tasks.visibility_requirement: Folded arms and hands visible against the statue backdrop; legs folded under, feet hidden.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎背靠石像模仿其姿态，双手交叠可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger stands on a rocky outcrop holding a large kite string, body braced against the wind as the kite pulls upward behind it.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands gripping string visible; both hind soles planted toward camera with four toes and yellow pads.
tasks.intent_zh: 老虎在岩石上迎风放风筝，双手与后脚掌清晰可见。
